title: Ankur Mishra
text: I’m an LLM researcher working on pretraining and reinforcement learning. Through Google TRC, I investigated strategies to reduce the KV cache bottleneck. What follows are writeups of my experiments, grouped by the codebase they came out of. Previously at Microsoft and AWS.
